6268.title: SDK Markdown omits thread-mention rendering
6268.rootCauseOneLine: PluginMarkdown omits the configuration that enables thread-mention parsing and pill rendering in MarkdownPreview.
6268.proposedFix: Enable the existing assistant-style thread-mention configuration in the SDK Markdown host renderer, with a real component and navigation regression test.
6268.caveats: Reproduced twice at the real SDK component boundary; desktop and the complete side-chat menu flow were not exercised. The complete regression test is inline in the report.
